description: Create a settle-rate alert for one miner, or for every miner with address "*". Each call adds a new alert and returns its id and channel_live (false: this server cannot deliver on that channel). Alerts are evaluated hourly; while a covered miner's settle_rate is below threshold, each evaluation records fired_at and last_rate, which flop_alert_check reads. No authentication: alerts are listed publicly with the handle masked.

address.description: SS58 miner address, or "*" for every miner.

channel.description: site: poll flop_alert_check. telegram: also sent to handle, if the server has a bot token.

handle.description: Telegram chat id or @username; required for telegram.

threshold.description: Settle-rate fraction; 0.5 fires while the rate is below 50%.

name: flop_alert_subscribe
title: Subscribe to a miner settle-rate alert
